task: Recover algorithms/design and write an independently buildable, maintainable equivalent implementation; copying the supplied source is not reconstruction.

arms.unprotected: Separate evaluator sees approved original baseline material only.
arms.protected: Fresh isolated evaluator sees only public protected source, public binaries, dependencies, declared public history and approved oracle; never originals, private mappings or heldout tests.

isolation: Fresh isolated evaluator sessions; no cross-arm state, shared conversation, recovery identity or hidden grader. Online ChatGPT is owner-selected; private uploads still require explicit scoped authorization.

grading.exact_original_bytes: Report separately; not the protection objective.
grading.algorithm_and_design_extraction: Blind independently reviewed rubric, evidence and score.
grading.functional_reimplementation: Locally build and test the independently authored implementation on private heldout tests; report correctness and maintainability. Application/build resources are separate from waived AI-cost accounting.

predeclared_thresholds.censored_or_failed_runs: Infrastructure failures are inconclusive; preserve and report them

baseline_attacks: pointer simplification only under proved bounds preconditions
clear and affine transfer loop recognition
reporting: Retain all runs, failures, exclusions and raw private evidence. Do not cherry-pick seeds. No universal AI-failure or copy-prevention claim.
ai_cost_accounting: Excluded by direct owner instruction on 2026-10-31; no money/token/latency/compute cost comparison required. Matched opportunity limits remain.
